🧪  `frames-devnet@v1.0.0`: https://github.com/ethereum/execution-specs/releases/tag/tests-frames-devnet@v1.0.0

**New in v1.0.0:**
- EIP-8141: expiry verifier deployed as an ordinary contract at `0x81413f0cF12e9b6a49B1D0439E081c577D57FfFf`, approval context rollback on revert above `APPROVE` [EIPs#12387](https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/12387), [EIPs#12458](https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/12458).

- EIP-8272: recent roots, recent root contract at `0x8272D9679689Ea2f307140CdF9002D27dC00Ffff` [EIPs#12443](https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/12443).
- EIP-7906: transaction assertions, `TXTRACE`/`TXDIFF`/`EVENTDATACOPY` at `0xb6`-`0xb8` and `POST_TX` assigned in the EIP [EIPs#12454](https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/12454), [EIPs#12461](https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/12461).

Thanks to <@830368514225340436>!
